vagas.title: Brownfield Offshore Coordinator
vagas.description: We are looking for our next Offshore Coordinator for Brownfield projects. Do you thrive in an offshore environment and enjoy coordinating complex activities involving multiple stakeholders? Are you someone who combines technical knowledge, strong planning skills, and a hands‑on approach to project execution? As we continue to strengthen our Brownfield project delivery capabilities, we are looking for a new colleague to join our team and support the successful execution of modifications, campaigns and operational projects across our FPSO fleet. In this role, you will act as a key interface between offshore operations and the project organization, ensuring that planned activities are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project objectives. You will play an important role throughout the project lifecycle, from preparation and mobilization through execution and close‑out, supporting coordination between offshore teams, contractors, vendors, and onshore stakeholders. You will contribute to maintaining high standards of HSE, quality and operational performance while helping to ensure that project activities are delivered in line with technical requirements, schedules, and regulatory expectations. The position requires a proactive mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic operational environment. We are looking for a candidate who is self‑driven, collaborative, and solution‑oriented, with solid offshore experience and a strong technical background. You should be comfortable working across disciplines, engaging with both operational and project teams, and taking ownership of activities from planning through execution. Responsibilities Ensure awareness of our HSE, Quality policy and business ethical standards are established and maintained throughout projects. Lead the projects and tasks related with Operations team offshore. Project Planning : develop the scope and execution schedule supporting the vendors surveyors, offshore leadership, and project engineer. Support onshore organization regarding vendor and equipment verification; site visits, manpower qualifications and FATs. Acquisition : support on material identification/specification and start procurement process (raise MRs). Project Preparation : prepare work‑packs for execution, materials identification, and related activities; provide quality assurance for efficient execution. Project Execution : responsible for third parties’ activities in the installation; act as liaison toward crew and onboard management; monitor progress and inspect HSEQ working practices; issue execution daily reports. Project Close‑out : ensure proper completion, material demobilization and project close‑out. Risk Management : identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to reduce project impacts. Documentation : prepare and organize technical project documentation. Communication : assist the Project Engineer as the link with the Offshore crew; lead meetings to provide transparent information; prepare and issue reports. Ensure that the design and construction of equipment & facilities as well as the project execution are compliant with the client’s specification, functional requirements, and regulatory requirements. Qualifications Background / Qualifications: Technicians/Engineers with technical background. Offshore experience is mandatory (minimum 3 years). Knowledge of technical drawings and equipment datasheets. Hard Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Project and Primavera is an advantage. Proficiency in English (reading, writing and conversation). Ability to read, analyse and interpret technical procedures in both Portuguese and English. Soft Skills: Structured, analytical and solution oriented. Team player who can work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks. Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities and unforeseen events. Proactive, with a strong sense of initiative and accountability. Strong coordination and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and collaborate with offshore and onshore teams, contractors and vendors. Leadership skills and the ability to work effectively within a multi‑disciplinary environment. Benefits We live by our #TEAM values – they always guide our actions, no compromises. People who are committed to excellence, developing their professional experience as they deliver organizational outcomes. Development opportunities where you may be part of internationally based project teams and collaborate with colleagues across our global organization. An open and collaborative workplace where you can have an immediate impact and contribute to the success of our operations. Challenging work in a dynamic offshore and project environment with exposure to a wide range of technical disciplines and stakeholders. A competitive total compensation package including health benefits, pension, incentive programmes and other local benefits. The opportunity to work alongside highly experienced professionals within one of the world’s leading offshore energy infrastructure companies. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: FARM | Estilista III - Malharia e Silk
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias. Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Responsabilidades e atribuições Perfil Profissional Buscamos um Estilista III com experiência em desenvolvimento de coleções de Malharia e Silk , unindo sensibilidade estética refinada à visão estratégica de negócio. Sua atuação será end-to-end: da pesquisa de tendências à aprovação técnica final (lacre). É fundamental possuir domínio técnico em estruturas de malha, caimento, processos produtivos e estamparia. Procuramos um perfil com olhar gráfico apurado, focado em performance, viabilidade produtiva e que transite com facilidade entre o estilo, equipe interna e fornecedores. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Inteligência Criativa: Pesquisar tendências, comportamento do consumidor e mercado para antecipar demandas de coleção. Estratégia de Produto: Desenvolver coleções alinhadas ao posicionamento da marca, equilibrando DNA criativo com metas comerciais. Expertise Técnica: Liderar o desenvolvimento de produtos em malharia, dominando processos de silk, beneficiamentos e inovação em bases. Gestão de Ciclo: Comandar o processo do briefing ao lacre, garantindo excelência em provas de roupa, ajustes de modelagem e validações técnicas. Engenharia de Ficha: Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas e assegurar a precisão das informações para a cadeia de suprimentos. Visão 360: Apoiar estrategicamente a definição de custos, viabilidade produtiva e análise de performance (sell-through) dos produtos. Mentoria: Orientar e desenvolver assistentes e estagiários, otimizando o fluxo de entregas e a qualidade criativa do time. Planejamento de Mix: Participar ativamente do planejamento da coleção, garantindo um mix de produtos equilibrado, comercialmente forte e inovador. Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos e Qualificações Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Moda, Design ou áreas correlatas. Experiência Sólida: Mínimo de 5 anos de atuação como Estilista, com cases de sucesso no desenvolvimento de coleções de Malharia . Domínio Técnico de Produto: Conhecimento em estruturas de malha, gramaturas, caimento e processos de lavanderia/beneficiamento. Expertise em Estamparia: Conhecimento em técnicas de Estamparia. Ferramentas Criativas: Domínio avançado do Pacote Adobe (Illustrator e Photoshop) focado em desenho técnico. Experiência com Procreate será considerada um facilitador. Visão Sistêmica e Dados: Habilidade intermediária em Excel para controles, cronogramas e análise de custos. Colaboração Remota: Domínio da ferramenta Miro para fluxos e organização visual de coleções. Idiomas: Inglês Avançado/Fluente , capacitado para pesquisas de tendências globais e possível contato com fornecedores internacionais. vagas.title: Contador General
vagas.description: ¡Únete a nuestro equipo como Contador/a General! En una importante oficina contable, buscamos a un profesional apasionado por los números, la normativa y la precisión. Si te gusta trabajar con información clave y mantener todo en orden, este puesto es para ti. Qué necesitas Licenciatura en Contabilidad con título y cédula profesional. Conocimiento sólido en NIF, normativa fiscal y disposiciones para emisoras. Interés en procesos de la BMV. Dominio de Excel avanzado, CONTPAQi y Microsoft Dynamics GP. Experiencia en contabilidad general, financiera y fiscal. Tu misión Asegurar que la información contable y financiera sea precisa, completa y entregada a tiempo, cumpliendo con los reportes regulatorios para la BMV y la CNBV. ¿Qué harás? Elaborar operaciones contables y elaborar estados financieros. Realizar conciliaciones, provisiones, cálculos y declaraciones de impuestos. Coordinar el informe anual (CNBV) y reportes semestrales para inversionistas. Integrar notas a los estados financieros con enfoque bursátil. Buscamos a alguien con Visión analítica. Organización impecable. Enfoque total en resultados. Te ofrecemos Ubicación: Cuauhtémoc, CDMX. Horario: L-V de 9:00 am a 6:00 pm (disponibilidad según carga de trabajo). Sueldo: $25,000- $28,000 brutos + Prestaciones de ley. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno
vagas.description: Sobre a Flowa A Flowa Technologies é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em mercado financeiro e pioneira no segmento de Electronic Trading. Desenvolvemos soluções tecnológicas robustas e eficientes voltadas para a negociação eletrônica de ativos financeiros nas principais bolsas das Américas. Atuando sob o conceito de “tecnologia como serviço”, atendemos as principais corretoras de valores, gestores de recursos e investidores institucionais do mercado. Temos o compromisso contínuo com o desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes, ágeis e que transformem a experiência de investir, priorizando a estabilidade, velocidade e segurança para os nossos clientes. Movidos por tecnologia e inovação, sede de aprendizado contínuo e vontade de fazer a diferença, somos um time comprometido e apaixonado pelo que fazemos. Estamos atualmente envolvidos em um projeto único: a criação de uma nova bolsa de valores para o Brasil. Junto com a nossa evolução, crescem os desafios e buscamos profissionais com iniciativa, motivados e com disposição para aprender. No seu dia a dia, você irá: Gerenciar e apoiar a evolução do programa de gestão de vulnerabilidades, incluindo acompanhamento de varreduras, priorização de riscos, interação com times responsáveis por remediação e reporte de indicadores; Gerenciar identidades e acessos ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos usuários (admissão, movimentação e desligamento), garantindo conformidade com políticas internas e aderência ao princípio de menor privilégio; Administrar e evoluir soluções de IAM e PAM, assegurando governança, rastreabilidade e controle de acessos críticos; Monitorar, investigar e tratar alertas de segurança com apoio de ferramentas como SIEM e EDR/XDR, contribuindo para a detecção e resposta a ameaças; Atuar de forma ativa junto ao Blue Team em iniciativas de defesa cibernética, resposta a incidentes e fortalecimento contínuo dos controles de segurança; Identificar oportunidades e implementar melhorias e automações em processos de gestão de acessos e segurança da informação; Conduzir e apoiar revisões periódicas de acessos, campanhas de certificação e auditorias internas e externas, garantindo aderência a requisitos regulatórios; Interagir com áreas de tecnologia, segurança, governança e negócios, assegurando alinhamento e uma abordagem integrada na gestão de identidades e acessos. O que você precisa: Graduação completa em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência comprovada com gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM) em ambientes corporativos; Boa capacidade de análise, senso crítico e atuação colaborativa com times multidisciplinares; Experiência prática com soluções de PAM e controle de acessos privilegiados; Experiência com soluções responsáveis por Gestão de Vulnerabilidades; Conhecimento de modelos de controle de acesso (como RBAC) e aplicação do princípio de menor privilégio. Serão considerados diferenciais: Experiência na implementação ou operação de cofres de senhas (PAM); Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de vulnerabilidades; Experiência com Segregação de Funções (SoD) e produção de evidências para auditorias de acessos; Experiência anterior no mercado financeiro ou em ambientes regulados. Benefícios Um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde todos são protagonistas e têm oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Digital Product Manager
vagas.description: Digital Product Manager Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first‑party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament‑time digital operations, delivering high‑traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross‑functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Provide clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross‑functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer‑first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI‑driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data‑driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g., Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g., PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end‑to‑end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct‑to‑consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short‑term opportunities. Competencies: Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data‑driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology: Strong knowledge of digital direct‑to‑consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry‑standard solutions, e.g., Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements: Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Agente Educativo Junior – Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio. Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Agente Educativo Jr. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Agente Educativo Jr será responsável por atuar no apoio às exposições e atividades do Centro Cultural Light, assistência e orientação ao público, apoio às atividades educativas, recreativas, imersivas e de lazer, bem como o apoio operacional às atividades programadas pela equipe educativa. Apoiar a recepção, orientação e organização do fluxo de visitantes às exposições e espaços museológicos do Centro Cultural Light; Auxiliar visitantes com necessidades especiais, garantindo acessibilidade adequada e uma experiência inclusiva; Orientar o público quanto às regras de visitação, conservação dos espaços e uso adequado dos equipamentos; Apoiar a execução de atividades recreativas, imersivas e lúdicas programadas pelo Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Educacional Light; Fornecer apoio logístico a atividades educativas, escritórios, visitas mediadas e atividades especiais; Apoiar a montagem, organização e desmontagem de materiais utilizados nas atividades; Contribuir para a manutenção do espaço expositivo, garantindo condições adequadas para a preservação de dois ambientes; Zelar pela correta utilização dos espaços de exposição e pela qualidade da experiência do visitante; Colaborar com a equipe do Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Light, garantindo apoio, segurança e organização durante esses anos; Elaborar relatórios diários das atividades realizadas. vagas.title: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Trophy Tour
vagas.description: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Trophy Tour Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA27 is established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy Tour exists to build anticipation and engagement ahead of the tournament, serving as a promotional platform to drive ticket sales, tourism, and global visibility. By bringing the Trophy to communities across Brazil and the world, it demonstrates FIFA’s truly global mission while positioning Brazilian host cities as vibrant, capable, and welcoming destinations at the heart of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Trophy Tour Manager will lead the planning, marketing and delivery of the Host Country phase of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Trophy Tour across Brazil, ensuring a cohesive, high‑impact and locally relevant execution across all Host Cities. They will also support moments on the Global Tour that require local stakeholders, particularly Brazilian Embassies in the 32 participating Member Associations. Acting as the central point of coordination in‑market, this role will drive alignment across FIFA’s global project team in Zurich, local stakeholders and all relevant internal functions. Working in close collaboration with the Experiential Marketing Manager in Zurich, the Manager will ensure that all FIFA Trophy Tour activities are strategically aligned, culturally relevant, and delivered to FIFA standards. The role will also support the global leg of the FIFA Trophy Tour where required, ensuring continuity and consistency between international and Host Country phases. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the development and execution of the Host Country FIFA Trophy Tour strategy and marketing approach across Brazil including all Host Cities. Ensure alignment with the overall FIFA Trophy Tour strategy, adapting where needed to maximize local relevance and impact. Act as the primary point of contact for the eight Host Cities, coordinating planning, timelines, and delivery expectations. Integrate with the wider FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project, identifying opportunities to amplify impact across other initiatives. Stakeholder management & governance Manage relationships with Host Cities, local authorities, agencies and key stakeholders, acting as FIFA’s representative in‑market. Serve as the source of truth on local context, sensitivities and opportunities, proactively informing the global team. Lead cross‑functional coordination across FIFA internal teams (Operations, Legends, Digital, Communications, Brand, Partnerships and Media) ensuring all workstreams are aligned, integrated and delivered against a unified plan. Maintain consistent alignment and information flow with the Zurich‑based FIFA team, proactively managing dependencies, timelines and decision‑making across global and local stakeholders. Oversee and approve local plans, including venues, run‑of‑show, schedules and promotional activities. Ensure compliance with FIFA rights, brand guidelines and partner commitments. Marketing, communications & content Oversee the development and execution of local promotional plans across channels (digital, media, partners, on‑the‑ground) in alignment with the broader global marketing and communications plan. Ensure Host City activations are culturally relevant, locally resonant and aligned with the overall campaign narrative. Inspire Host Cities and hosts to invest as many resources as possible to deliver the best FIFA Trophy Tour events. Lead coordination of media activities in‑market, approved by the project team and FIFA Communications. Oversee content capture, approvals and distribution across FIFA channels and stakeholders (including .com, CRM, VNRs and social platforms). On‑site delivery & operations Represent FIFA on‑site across selected FIFA Trophy Tour stops in Brazil and support on global stops if needed. Oversee delivery of FIFA communications, promotional and content activities, ensuring high‑quality execution and stakeholder experience. Ensure proper representation, handling and protection of FIFA assets, including the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy and FIFA Legend. Coordinate on‑site stakeholders to ensure smooth operations, including media, partners and local teams. Reporting & performance tracking Monitor progress of the FIFA Trophy Tour across Host Cities and ensure timely escalation of risks or issues. Provide regular and comprehensive reporting on activities, performance and key learnings. Contribute to post‑event evaluation and recommendations for future FIFA Trophy Tours. Global coordination Support the Zurich‑based project team on the global leg where required. Coordinate with FIFA27 Government Relations to pitch FIFA Trophy Tour opportunities to Brazilian Government representatives and embassies for inclusion in both phases of the tour to facilitate their involvement in official events and support local engagement opportunities. Ensure continuity and consistency between the global and Host Country phases, capturing and sharing key learnings to inform delivery across the tour. YOUR PROFILE Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing. Minimum of 5 years of work experience in Marketing and Events or Experiential projects, ideally within sport or major international events. Preferred previous experience in football and/or professional sports. Strong understanding of sports marketing, including sponsorship, brand communication and fan engagement. Proven ability to deliver integrated marketing communications and promotional campaigns across online and offline channels. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast‑paced and evolving environment. Experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including at senior level. Demonstrated ability to work cross‑functionally, building strong relationships and aligning diverse teams towards a shared objective. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to navigate discussions, resolve issues and drive decisions in a constructive and controlled manner. High level of adaptability and resilience, with the ability to respond to changing priorities, evolving plans and a dynamic operating environment. Comfortable working across time zones and flexible working hours, with willingness to travel extensively as required. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools (e.g., Monday.com). Requirements Fluent in English and Portuguese. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Esta é uma posição estratégica, responsável por garantir eficiência, otimização e excelência nas operações logísticas da empresa.**Responsabilidades da função*** Planejar e otimizar as operações logísticas, garantindo prazos, qualidade e acuracidade.* Analisar indicadores, identificar oportunidades e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos.* Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Operações, Supply Chain, Transportes e demais setores.* Utilizar ferramentas e sistemas de gestão logística para apoiar decisões.* Participar do desenvolvimento de projetos de inovação e aprimoramento operacional.* Assegurar fluidez, organização e padronização dos fluxos logísticos.* Capacidade de desenhar fluxograma multifuncional com análise crítica de processos* Capacidade de elaborar instruções de trabalho (IT) e ministrar treinamento para a equipe**Requisitos**Experiência comprovada na área de Logística, Supply Chain, Planejamento ou Melhoria Contínua.* Vivência com análise de dados, indicadores logísticos e ferramentas de otimização.* Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão logística (WMS, TMS, ERP ou similares).* Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de análise (Power BI, Google Data Studio ou equivalentes).* Capacidade de interpretar dados e transformar análises em ações práticas.**Formação*** Ensino Superior completo em: Logística, Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas.* Pós-graduação será um diferencial.* Cursos complementares em Melhoria Contínua (Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma) serão considerados diferenciais relevantes.**Competências desejadas*** Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados.* Boa comunicação e capacidade de articulação entre áreas.* Organização, senso de prioridade e visão sistêmica.* Proatividade e abertura para inovação.* Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e conduzir melhorias de forma colaborativa.Na Venancio, valorizamos a inovação, a melhoria contínua e a busca constante pela excelência. Se você é um profissional que deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento, **esta é a sua chance**.**Junte-se à Venancio e contribua diretamente para a evolução da nossa operação logística!**---### Requirements##### StudiesPostgraduate - Specialization/MBALogisticsProduction/industrial engineering---### Valued##### Professional experienceBetween 1 and 3 years---### About VenancioBEM-VINDOS À MAIS AMADA DO RIO! QUEM SOMOS Somos a Venancio, uma marca carioca que há mais de 46 anos coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 140 lojas físicas e mais de 5.000 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios, Volta Redonda, Cabo Frio e São Pedro da Aldeia. Por meio dos nossos canais digitais, ampliamos a atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil. Temos orgulho de ter sido eleitos pela Veja Rio como a Farmácia Mais Amada do Rio de Janeiro – um reconhecimento que celebra a confiança e o carinho de todos que fazem parte da nossa história. NOSSO PROPÓSITO Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além de medicamentos: é sobre qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar. Em 2014, expandimos nossa atuação com a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio especializada no mercado hospitalar e distribuição farmacêutica. E para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte. O QUE NOS TORNA ÚNICOS - Nossa essência carioca - O acolhimento genuíno no atendimento - A busca constante por inovação Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e atuamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa. E a Venancio não para: até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos crescendo, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar. CRESÇA COM A GENTE! Para levar as melhores sensações aos nossos clientes, precisamos de pessoas que trabalhem realizadas e comprometidas em alcançar a excelência no nosso atendimento. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha fazer parte desse time que transforma vidas todos os dias. #VemSerVenancio #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Engenheiro Comercial
vagas.description: Atuar como responsável técnico-comercial pelo atendimento às demandas dos clientes, sendo encarregado de receber solicitações, entender necessidades técnicas, realizar visitas em campo, propor soluções elétricas, elaborar orçamentos técnicos e comerciais, além de direcionar, revisar e validar os orçamentos e projetos elétricos desenvolvidos pela equipe, assegurando a viabilidade técnica, econômica e operacional das soluções propostas. O cargo é estratégico e operacional, exigindo forte domínio técnico, visão de custos, capacidade de comunicação com clientes e integração entre orçamento, projeto e fabricação de painéis elétricos de baixa tensão. PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO Elaborar projetos técnicos de painéis elétricos de baixa tensão (e soluções associadas), e também orientar/revisar os projetos feitos pela equipe. Elaborar orçamentos técnicos e comerciais, fazendo: Levantamento de quantitativos de materiais, equipamentos e serviços; Composição de custos (diretos, indiretos, margens/BDI); Análise de prazos, riscos e viabilidade técnico- econômica. Coordenar tecnicamente a equipe de orçamento e projetos: Definindo o escopo e premissas; Revisando e validando entregas; Garantindo padrão técnico, coerência e qualidade. Atender o cliente tecnicamente: Realizando (ou validando) visitas técnicas; Entendendo a necessidade real do cliente (técnica, operacional e normativa); Traduzindo isso em escopo claro e solução técnica adequada. Propor solução técnica: Definindo a arquitetura do painel, proteções, comandos, automação; Escolhendo componentes e soluções compatíveis com custo, norma e prazo. Avaliar viabilidade e riscos: Técnicos, financeiros, produtivos e de prazo; Antecipar problemas antes de virar erro em fábrica ou campo. Responsável pelo fechamento e acompanhamento das propostas: Ciclo completo das propostas, desde a solicitação inicial até a definição da solução técnica e entrega do orçamento ao cliente e posterior follow-up, até que o ciclo do orçamento seja encerrado; Garantindo alinhamento entre escopo, orçamento, projeto e execução. Interpretar diagramas elétricos e aplicar normas técnicas e de segurança (NR-10, ABNT, IEC), assegurando a viabilidade e segurança das soluções. Sugerir melhorias em processos, padrões técnicos, soluções de engenharia e procedimentos de orçamentação. Definir prioridades e distribuir demandas entre os integrantes da equipe de orçamento e projetos, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e qualidade técnica das entregas. Formação superior em Engenharia Elétrica ou Engenharia de Controle e Automação. Registro ativo no CREA (exigência legal para a função). Conhecimento de sistemas elétricos de baixa tensão. Vivência comprovada em elaboração de orçamentos técnicos. Domínio de softwares de desenho e projeto elétrico (AutoCAD, EPLAN, CAD elétrico ou similar). Conhecimentos em automação e instrumentação (definição de sensores, atuadores, lógica de controle, PLCs, etc.). Conhecimento em normas de segurança elétrica, normas técnicas aplicáveis (NR10, SPDA, aterramento, proteção, etc.). Leitura e interpretação de desenhos mecânicos / estruturas / montagem. Familiaridade com ERP, preferencialmente Omie. Necessário experiência em projetos e orçamentos de sistemas elétricos, preferencialmente em empresas fabricantes de painéis elétricos. Experiência em vendas, fechamento de propostas e rotinas comerciais. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Program Lead - LATAM
vagas.description: Senior Program Lead delivering complex OTT/video programmes across LATAM, managing global teams, customers, and end-to-end delivery success. This role sits at the centre of customer delivery, working closely with global engineering teams, product, architecture, and operations to ensure successful execution of complex technology programmes. The successful candidate will act as the primary delivery interface for key customers in LATAM, partnering closely with the LATAM Account Director to ensure strong customer relationships, seamless execution, and consistent delivery against commercial and technical objectives. This is a highly customer-facing, fast-paced role requiring strong leadership in ambiguous environments, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a deep understanding of end-to-end technology deliver. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale OTT and video technology programmes across LATAM. Manage cross-functional delivery teams spanning global engineering, product, architecture, and operations. Act as the primary delivery interface for customers, working closely with the LATAM Account Director. Ensure all programmes are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned to customer expectations. Own programme governance, reporting, risk management, dependency tracking, and escalation processes across multiple workstreams. Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders across the LATAM region. Coordinate with global delivery leads to ensure alignment across technical execution and programme delivery. Support commercial and account teams in customer engagement, change requests, and delivery assurance activities. Required Experience & Skills Proven experience delivering large-scale, end-to-end OTT, video, or complex technology programmes. Strong background in programme or project leadership within media, telecoms, streaming, or digital platforms. Experience working with global, distributed engineering and delivery teams. Strong customer-facing experience, including engagement with senior stakeholders across technical and commercial functions. Excellent understanding of programme governance, risk management, planning, and dependency management. Fluent English is essential. Portuguese and/or Spanish language skills are required. Preferred Profile Based in Brazil, ideally near Rio de Janeiro. Experience working with LATAM-based customers and regional delivery environments. Background in OTT, streaming, broadcast, or video technology ecosystems. Strong relationship-building skills with a proven ability to operate in customer-facing delivery roles. Experience or understanding of cloud-based, consumption-driven commercial models is highly advantageous. Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with a strong focus on outcomes. Key Success Measures Successful delivery of complex OTT and video programmes across LATAM markets. High levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Consistent on-time and on-budget programme execution. Strong alignment between customer, account, and engineering teams. Effective management of delivery risk, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. The Opportunity We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges: Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency. Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems. Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets. System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems. Rapid Delivery: Adopt a ‘deliver fast’ mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards. Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more): Streaming & High-Throughput Data Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time. Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings. GenAI & Autonomous Agents Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating. Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers Graph & Knowledge Engineering Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data. Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal. The Technology Stack We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track. Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes. Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data. GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs. Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search). Desired Profile Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph. Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable. You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Must Haves: 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development. Advanced English communication skills. Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms. Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI). Good to Have: Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB). GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA). Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments. Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. vagas.title: AZZAS F&L | Especialista de Projetos Estratégicos | Labs
vagas.description: Vale transporte Parceria com o SESC No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias. Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Projetos Estratégicos para atuar diretamente com a liderança de Tecnologia, dentro da nossa iniciativa de IA corporativa. É uma posição para quem gosta de entrar em problemas complexos, conduzir análises profundas com autonomia e sair com recomendações que geram decisão e impacto. O trabalho é variado por natureza: a cada ciclo, uma oportunidade diferente do negócio — identificada pela alta liderança — pode virar o seu próximo projeto. O que você vai fazer Atuar como braço analítico ligado diretamente ao diretor de Tecnologia. À medida que a alta liderança identifica oportunidades relevantes no negócio, esta posição é alocada para entrar no problema, conduzir a análise de ponta a ponta e sair com recomendações concretas e acionáveis — atuando também na implementação quando o projeto pedir. O que buscamos 4 a 5 anos de experiência em funções analíticas exigentes — consultoria estratégica, estratégia/BizOps, M&A, banco de investimento, ou áreas equivalentes. Capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos e conduzi-los até uma recomendação concreta com pouca supervisão. Raciocínio quantitativo forte e conforto com dados (SQL e/ou Python são diferenciais relevantes). Comunicação executiva clara — escrita e verbal — com diretoria e C-level. Fluência ou disposição genuína em usar ferramentas de IA como parte central do trabalho analítico. Autonomia, senso de dono e maturidade para navegar diferentes áreas do grupo. Diferenciais (nice to have) Experiência em concepção ou desenvolvimento de produtos/projetos digitais. Vivência em ambientes de varejo, moda, e-commerce ou bens de consumo. Responsabilidades e atribuições Decompor problemas de negócio ambíguos em hipóteses claras, frentes de análise e um plano de ataque — partindo de um direcionamento inicial da liderança e conduzindo o resto com autonomia. Conduzir análises quantitativas e qualitativas robustas: estruturar dados, dimensionar oportunidades, modelar cenários e pressionar as próprias conclusões antes de apresentá-las. Entregar complete staff work: chegar até o final do raciocínio e apresentar recomendações prontas para decisão, com trade‑offs explícitos e premissas declaradas — não análises em aberto que devolvem o problema para quem pediu. Usar ferramentas de IA como alavanca central de análise — acelerando pesquisa, processamento de dados, prototipagem de soluções e geração de insumos para decisão. Traduzir análise em comunicação executiva: documentos e apresentações diretos, bem estruturados e proporcionais à decisão em jogo, voltados a CEO e diretoria. Participar da implementação das recomendações quando aplicável — acompanhando execução, ajustando o curso com base em resultados e garantindo que a análise vire impacto real. Trabalhar lado a lado com as áreas donas de cada problema, navegando contextos distintos do grupo (marcas, varejo, operações, digital) sem gerar atrito de "área que audita área". Requisitos e qualificações Ensino superior completo em Exatas (Administração, Engenharias, Matemática, etc.). Domínio de Excel avançado. Conhecimento em programação (SQL) e banco de dados. Experiência em varejo e projetos será considerado um diferencial. Experiência com ferramentas de IA será considerado um diferencial. Nossos Benefícios Esta empresa oferece um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem‑estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história. Saúde e bem estar Plano de saúde. Plano odontológico. Seguro de vida. Programas de bem‑estar físico, como Wellhub ou TotalPass. Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental. Dia a dia e qualidade de vida Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash. Vale transporte. Parceria com o SESC. Clube de vantagens com parceiros. Day off de aniversário. Extensão de licença maternidade. Extensão de licença paternidade. Descontos nas marcas do grupo. Desenvolvimento e crescimento Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento. Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas. Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento. Reconhecimento Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente. Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia. Sonhar grande para fazer gigante, com gente boa e do bem. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Principal Package Management Spec
vagas.description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Experiência em processos de licenciamento ambiental e/ou segurança industrial será considerada um diferencial. Conhecimentos Técnicos Desenvolvimento técnico de projetos desde a fase de pré-viabilidade e anteprojeto até o projeto básico para licenciamento. Definição do conceito de planta, elaboração de balanços de massa e energia, diagramas de processo (PFD/P&ID em nível de licenciamento), layouts e critérios de projeto. Conhecimento dos processos de tramitação administrativa, incluindo licenciamento ambiental, autorizações integradas e licenças setoriais. Gestão de interfaces de projeto (rede de gás, eletricidade, água/efluentes, acessos, servidões e terceiros). Benefícios Plano de Saúde Unimed Nacional (empresa custeia 80%). As the IP Networks Team Lead, you will be responsible for designing, operating, and evolving our global IP backbone and data center networks, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and highly available. This role blends technical leadership and hands‑on engineering, guiding the team in building and maintaining next‑generation network infrastructure across our on‑prem and cloud environments. You will act as both a technical authority and people leader, responsible for defining network architecture standards, enforcing best practices, and managing priorities across multiple initiatives. We are open to hiring this role in São Paulo, Brazil. Fluency in English is essential for this role. About the Role Lead, mentor, and develop a team of network engineers, managing performance, priorities, and technical direction Design, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, data center, and backbone network infrastructure Architect and operate high‑availability global IP networks interconnecting data centers and cloud regions Ensure network redundancy and resilience testing across service, infrastructure, and transport layers Plan and oversee SDN and SD‑WAN to enable automation and dynamic traffic engineering Deploy and manage routers, switches, and firewalls Implement and maintain IPv6, QoS, and traffic‑engineering policies to guarantee consistent network performance Monitor network health, performance, and capacity, ensuring high availability, low latency, and reliability Investigate complex network incidents, lead root‑cause analysis, and ensure follow‑up actions are implemented Ensure network security and compliance with internal policies and industry standards (ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS, CIS) Automate network provisioning, configuration, and monitoring using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools Continuously improve observability and visibility using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and SNMP‑based systems Support migrations, upgrades, and expansions while minimizing downtime and risk Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, topology diagrams, and operational procedures Generate regular network performance and incident reports with actionable recommendations About You Must Have Experience: 10+ years as an IP/Networking Engineer, with expertise in designing, deploying, and managing high‑availability, scalable intercontinental networks (including at least 2+ years in a leadership role) Mobile IP Networks & Backhaul: Extensive experience designing and managing IP‑based mobile backhaul networks for 4G/5G, ensuring seamless delivery of traffic, data, and voice services SD‑WAN & SDN: Proven expertise with SD‑WAN and SDN technologies like high‑performance, reliable connectivity Data Center & Backbone Design: Skilled in designing and managing global IP backbones and interconnected data centers for high-performance, low‑latency connections Advanced Network Protocols: Expert‑level knowledge in TCP/IP stack, including TCP, UDP, ICMP, SMTP, SNMP, LDAP, DNS, NTP, and other essential protocols. Proficient in dynamic routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and MPLS Network Security & Compliance: Expertise in IPSec VPNs, security hardening, and compliance frameworks (PCI‑DSS, ISO 27001, CIS) Layer 2 & Layer 3 Management: Hands‑on experience managing Layer 2 (STP, MSTP) and Layer 3 multiservice networks with MPLS and traffic engineering Network Automation & IaC: Proficient in Terraform, Ansible, and other tools to automate network provisioning and streamline deployments Network Monitoring & Observability: Expertise in tools like Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP, and Wireshark for network monitoring and performance optimization High‑Performance Networking: Proven ability to design and optimize solutions for WAN optimization, traffic engineering, and latency reduction Leadership & Collaboration: Strong leadership skills in mentoring engineers, driving network strategy, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams Nice to Have Knowledge of Python for network automation, data collection, or tooling development Hands‑on experience with redundancy validation, chaos testing, or network failover simulation Familiarity with multi‑cloud networking and hybrid‑connectivity architectures Experience integrating network telemetry into performance and reliability dashboards Experience collaborating with global carriers, IXPs, and data center providers Benefits CLT contract – enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day Extended parental leave – 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old – R$500 per month per child Why 1GLOBAL? Use social listening tools to gather insights and trends for stakeholders across marketing, creative, and digital content teams. Work closely with marketing, PR, creative services, and other departments to support overall business goals. Collaborate with content creators, designers, and copywriters to produce high‑quality content. Act as the primary social media liaison between the Zurich‑based global team and the US‑based event teams. Adjust strategies based on data to improve reach, engagement, and conversion rates. Ensure collaboration and content optimisation with other stakeholders in the Digital Marketing group, including colleagues working on owned‑and‑operated platforms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Languages Fluent in English and Portuguese. Technology Experience/Proficiency with Google Analytics, Keyhole, Canva, PowerPoint, Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Adobe Creative Cloud. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Strong grounding in mechanical engineering fundamentals, with experience in component design and manufacturing for industrial equipment. Proficiency with computer-aided design and analysis applications (CAD, CFD, FEA). Design justification experience via analysis and calculation — FEA, stress, and thermal calculations. Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards and legislation. Experience with equipment troubleshooting and report generation for complex mechanical or electromechanical systems. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to read technical documentation, drawings, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality & Compliance, and external suppliers to support equipment builds, deployments, and resolution of technical issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail, accuracy, and documentation discipline across drawings, calculations, procedures, and reports. Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing project plans from high-level direction and delivering reliably against schedule and milestones. Pragmatic decision‑maker, able to weigh business priorities and contribute to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in test environments, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, equally comfortable working with established processes or helping to develop and refine new ones. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Familiarity with electromechanical fundamentals and the assembly, maintenance, and testing of complex electromechanical systems. Experience with hydraulics, and with drilling tool design. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. vagas.title: ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
vagas.description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, control, and project management to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking an engineer with 5+ years' experience in power-electronics design, testing, and manufacturing, as well as prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. The ideal candidate will be equally well versed in design, analysis, and test. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the development of power-electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems for our downhole drilling technologies. The role spans schematic design, prototype bring-up, validation testing, and field support — working closely with mechanical, firmware, and systems engineers, and providing direct technical support to operations and drilling crews during testing and deployments. Responsibilities Design & Development Develop power electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems and control applications. Create system block diagrams, schematics, wiring harnesses, and detailed electrical designs using engineering CAD software. Design and implement electrical stress tests (e.g., pressure, temperature, vibration) to ensure product reliability and durability. Look ahead at validation requirements, and develop and execute test plans and setups using both firmware and hardware debugging tools. Testing, Validation & Field Support Conduct prototype board bring-up, functional testing, and performance analysis. Troubleshoot electronic faults at the component and system level using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. Provide technical support to field service technicians and on-site drilling crews to resolve operational problems. Collaborate across mechanical, firmware, systems, and project teams on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture and ensure that all activities adhere to HSE policy. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of power electronics engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Experience with high-voltage transmission and protection, and motor control electronic circuits (motor drivers, position feedback) used in oil & gas drilling, electric actuators, automation systems, electric vehicles, and similar applications. Experience with DC-DC converters (Buck/Boost, Flyback) used in power supplies across industrial and consumer electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Experience with analog and digital filters used across transmission networks, radio, satellite, medical devices, and oil & gas sensors and signal monitoring. Experience with sensors found in industrial and commercial electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Proficiency with electronics simulation and CAD tools used to model, simulate, and design electronic devices. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong analytical thinking and ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working directly with operations teams, field service technicians, and on-site drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and resolution of operational problems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Strong attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and configuration control. Demonstrated ability to work independently, execute project plans from high-level direction, and deliver reliably against schedule and milestones. Experience contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working in the lab, on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping evolve them as systems mature. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSEE or MSEE preferred. Experience with embedded firmware development for high-voltage or motor control applications. Exposure to oil & gas, drilling, or downhole electronics qualification standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
vagas.description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, and control to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking a mechanical technician with 3+ years' experience in lab and field testing of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for downhole drilling systems, including assembly, prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the hands‑on assembly, testing, and maintenance of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for our downhole drilling systems — running functional and performance tests in the lab and supporting prototype bring‑up, qualification campaigns, and operational deployments in the field. You will work alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, capturing test data and feeding it back into design and reliability improvements. Responsibilities Conduct functional tests, performance evaluations, and calibrations on mechanical and electromechanical equipment to ensure compliance with quality standards and manufacturer specifications. Set up and operate test equipment — pressure and temperature test rigs, hydraulic test benches, torque tools, dimensional metrology (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and data acquisition systems — to run characterization, qualification, and acceptance testing. Diagnose and repair mechanical and hydraulic failures at the component and assembly level, including disassembly, inspection, replacement of worn or damaged parts, and rework of seals, fasteners, and fittings. Support prototype bring‑up and design iterations by capturing test data, flagging anomalies, and feeding observations back to mechanical and systems engineers. Assembly, Field Support & Documentation Assemble, disassemble, inspect, and perform preventative maintenance on mechanical and hydraulic equipment (downhole tools, actuators, drillstring components, pumps, valves, and associated test fixtures) according to technical specifications and procedures. Maintain accurate service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation, and generate clear reports on work performed and equipment status. Provide hands‑on support to field representatives and drilling crews during qualification campaigns and deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Coordinate with other technicians, engineers, and field representatives to resolve complex issues, support failure analysis, and ensure seamless equipment deployment. Help maintain an organized work environment and manage inventory of electronic components, parts, and supplies. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and hydraulic equipment and generating clear service and calibration reports. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data acquisition and diagnostic software, plus strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. Customer Interface & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Experience working alongside engineers, field representatives, and drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and on‑site troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to capture lab and field test observations as clear, actionable feedback for engineering. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail and discipline in service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation. Ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing assigned tasks reliably against schedule and procedures. Contributes to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement based on test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast‑moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in the lab, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping refine them as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback that improves equipment performance and reliability. Nice to have Associate degree or higher in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related discipline. Experience with downhole tools, drillstring components, or other oilfield mechanical equipment. Familiarity with calibration management systems and qualification testing standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high‑temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra‑deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr
