vagas.title: SIMULATION ENGINEER - JUNIOR
vagas.description: Overview GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. We are looking for a Junior Simulation Engineer to help develop, run, and improve simulation models for mechanical, hydraulic, thermal, and downhole drilling systems. You will work with experienced engineers, receive technical guidance, and take responsibility for clearly scoped modeling, analysis, scripting, and reporting tasks. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro city - RJ. The opportunity for you You will work closely with engineers across simulation, mechanical design, testing, and product development. The role includes mentorship and technical review, but also expects you to manage assigned tasks, document assumptions, communicate blockers early, and turn analysis results into clear next steps. Responsibilities Modeling & Simulation Build and update simulation models using tools such as MATLAB, Simulink, and Simscape. Model physical systems across mechanical, hydraulic, and thermal domains under guidance from senior engineers. Apply numerical methods to help predict system behavior and compare model outputs against expected results. Prepare, run, and review finite element or fluid dynamics simulations using tools such as Ansys or OpenFOAM. Develop scripts and small tools for simulation workflows, data processing, and result visualization. Analyze simulation outputs and summarize findings in clear technical reports. Read engineering drawings, schematics, and requirements to translate physical systems into model inputs and assumptions. Collaborate with engineers across disciplines on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Follow health, safety, environmental, and quality procedures. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge Degree, advanced coursework, or equivalent practical experience in mechanical, mechatronics, aerospace, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field. Academic, internship, lab, or project experience with simulation, numerical methods, physics-based modeling, or engineering analysis. Basic understanding of mechanics, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, system modeling, or numerical methods. Programming ability in Python and C++ for engineering scripts, simulation workflows, and data processing. Ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering instructions. Clear written and verbal communication for collaboration and technical reporting. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Analytical thinking, curiosity, and comfort asking for guidance when information is incomplete. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Willingness to engage with engineering teams, test personnel, and — under guidance — customer-facing activities to support testing and troubleshooting. Clear communication skills, with the ability to capture test observations and translate them into structured notes and engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Attention to detail and a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and following configuration control practices. Ability to take ownership of clearly scoped tasks and see them through from preparation to close-out, asking for guidance when needed. Eagerness to contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions, learning from test and field results. Comfort working in fast-moving, technically challenging environments while maintaining rigor in your work. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures and an open mindset as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient, with an interest in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Nice to have Experience with MATLAB, Simulink, or Simscape. Exposure to Ansys, OpenFOAM, finite element analysis, or computational fluid dynamics. Experience validating model results against tests, hand calculations, or expected system behavior. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Avaliar, realizar prognóstico, estabelecer o tipo de consistência alimentar, indicar via alternativa quando necessário, adequar as funções para retirada de sonda com segurança, controlar risco de broncoaspiração e acelerar o processo de alta. Elaborar programas de tratamento fonoterápico, de acordo com diagnóstico médico e fonoaudiológico clínico; indicar exames complementares quando necessário e técnicas disponíveis. Prescrever e orientar a utilização de recursos a serem aplicados em todas as fases do tratamento, através de ações preventivas, restauradoras, de suporte e paliativa. Orientar pacientes e cuidadores quanto às condutas adotadas em sua recuperação, através da demonstração, treinamento e avaliação da execução das técnicas, a fim de obter êxito no tratamento e conscientizar da importância no processo de recuperação ou controle dos sintomas. Desenvolver terapias de reabilitação de distúrbios da comunicação oral, voz e linguagem, usando técnicas e métodos indicados para cada caso, visando a reabilitação do paciente. Realizar exames orofaciais em pacientes, avaliando posturas musculares em repouso e em movimento, tonicidade, movimentos involuntários e habilidades de lábios e língua, formato do palato e da face, para avaliar harmonia e função dos órgãos fonoarticulares. Avaliar e identificar as fases comprometidas da deglutição, observando estruturas e funcionamento, classificando disfagias e definindo condutas terapêuticas para reabilitação. Analisar e avaliar pacientes ao longo do tratamento, observando evolução, promovendo ajustes necessários na terapia adotada e emitindo laudos e pareceres técnicos baseados no histórico de cada paciente. Participar da elaboração de protocolos de tratamento junto à equipe multidisciplinar, definindo diretrizes em relação a cada área específica e afins. Participar das discussões clínicas (rounds) e reuniões de equipe. Contratação como Pessoa Jurídica Qualificação Diploma de Graduação/Bacharelado em Fonoaudiologia Especialização em Fonoaudiologia Hospitalar Experiência na área hospitalar Conhecimento do negócio/perfil dos grupos de cuidado Missão, visão e valores Institucionais #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Software Developer, Level II - SeaPower
vagas.description: About this position Build your career with Kraken Robotics. Make a difference to others. If innovation drives you, and you want a career that makes a difference to the world, helping humanity overcome the challenges in our oceans – safely, efficiently, and sustainably – then come join us at Kraken Robotics. Kraken Robotics is currently seeking a Software Developer, Level II - SeaPower . This position can be fully remote within Brazil or hybrid/in-office in Rio de Janeiro or Salvador. The Software Developer Level II will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining backend software components within Kraken’s SeaPower ecosystem. This role involves working on features and tools that support Kraken’s subsea battery systems—such as battery chargers, diagnostic applications, and simulation models for batteries and power communication systems. The position requires ownership of assigned development tasks, collaboration with cross‑functional teams, and active participation in all stages of the software development lifecycle. Operating within a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment, the Intermediate Developer will contribute to delivering reliable, high‑quality software while expanding technical skills and influencing product direction. Roles and Responsibilities Feature Development: Independently design, implement, test, and maintain backend components within the SeaPower application ecosystem, ensuring code quality and alignment with project requirements. Software Development Lifecycle: Take active ownership of assigned features through all development stages, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation. Code Review & Mentorship: Participate in code reviews to maintain high-quality standards and begin providing guidance and feedback to junior developers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, hardware teams, and other engineers to coordinate development efforts and deliver features on schedule. Test Automation & DevOps: Contribute to enhancing test coverage and improving CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Requirements Analysis: Collaborate in refining functional and technical requirements, helping to translate them into clear, actionable development tasks. Documentation & Process Adherence: Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation and adhere to established software development processes and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience Educational Background Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Nice to have: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields. Professional Experience 3-6 years’ experience with high-level device software development, tools, and practices. Strong proficiency in Linux-based system development. Strong knowledge of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), STL, and object-oriented design. Experience writing automated tests: unit, integration and end-to-end. Familiarity with build systems (CMake, Make) and debugging tools (gdb, Valgrind). Experience using development tools and libraries such as Git, GTest. Familiarity with containerization using Docker. Nice to have Knowledge of basic electrical engineering concepts. Exposure to microservice development using gRPC/protobuf. Experience with Python. Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies. Experience with software‑hardware interaction and system‑level design. Exposure to CI/CD technologies, especially GitLab CI and/or Buildbot. Experience with Autoproj or other build systems for robotics. Experience with robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS or ROS2). Experience with simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo). Personal Skills Self‑motivated and capable of working independently. Ability to adapt to changing work environments and manage competing demands. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team environment. Willingness to Travel At least once a quarter to one of Kraken's offices if fully remote. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Eletricista Manutenção I
vagas.description: Eletricista Manutenção I Job type: Full-time employee Valorizamos a Diversidade e Inclusão, buscamos pluralidade de perfis, gêneros, raças, orientações e identidades, porque acreditamos que contribuições e percepções de pessoas distintas nos ajudam a encontrar, juntos, soluções novas e sustentáveis em saúde. Responsabilidades Cumprir com as atividades de manutenção previstas nos planos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva das instalações, sistemas de distribuição elétrica e equipamentos acionados eletricamente. Receber e preencher as ordens de serviço de manutenção planejada e não planejada apontando ações executadas, materiais utilizados e tempos decorridos das atividades. Participar em estudos para nacionalização e substituição de componentes importados. Solicitar, quando necessário, contato com técnicos especialistas para troca de informações visando soluções de problemas de manutenção. Dar a assistência e suporte técnico necessário aos operadores da equipe de manutenção de forma a garantir a produtividade e a integridade dos equipamentos, dispositivos e sistemas elétricos. Atender prontamente aos clientes internos e externos sempre que solicitado nos assuntos inerentes às atividades realizadas. Elaborar lista de materiais necessários para a realização de intervenções de manutenção preventiva. Manter atualizados os registros de manutenção dos equipamentos e sistemas elétricos de modo a garantir a integridade dos históricos de manutenção. Participar na regulagem, ajustes, reparos, consertos, montagem, desmontagem de equipamentos e sistemas elétricos incluindo utilidades. Executar infraestrutura para a instalação elétrica de máquinas e equipamentos novos ou fazer o remanejamento dos mesmos quando da mudança de layout e reformas. Efetuar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e corretiva em painéis de distribuição de força e controle de baixa tensão. Apoiar as manutenções planejadas e não planejadas das subestações elétricas de alta tensão classe 15 kV e dos grupos geradores de energia elétrica de baixa tensão. Apoiar a elaboração de projetos e executar a montagem de painéis de comando e proteção e de distribuição de baixa tensão. Entre outras atividades com patíveis com o cargo. Requisitos Formação Técnica em Eletrotécnico, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas. Desejável vivência anterior na atividade. Necessário formação em NR 10 e SEP. Benefícios Assistência médica. Assistência odontológica. Vale alimentação. Farmácia/Dispensário com medicamentos gratuitos para você, pais, cônjuge e filhos. Previdência privada para que possa planejar seu futuro. Tem filhos? Você terá direito à creche (conforme unidade trabalho). Salão de beleza para que possa cuidar da sua saúde. Academia para cuidar da sua saúde. Programas de desenvolvimento, que oferecem parcerias em instituições de ensino com desconto. Licença maternidade. Licença paternidade estendida. Localização e Horário Local: Gardênia Azul - Jacarepaguá Horário: Disponibilidade para turnos - 06h às 15h ou 12h às 21h, com sábados alternados Disponibilidade de mudança: para Montes Claros - MG #J-18808-Ljbffr

Articulate Fitch’s credit views, rating rationales, and sector outlook in a clear, engaging, and commercially aware manner through meetings, conference calls, written commentary, and published research. Contribute to the strategic direction and visibility of Fitch’s Latin America CIPF franchise , including representing Fitch in conferences, industry forums, and client events. Support the management of the regional portfolio across multiple regulatory environments, ensuring high analytical standards, consistency, and timeliness in rating actions and research output. Partner closely with colleagues across sectors, countries, and analytical groups to advance the One CIPF approach and strengthen Fitch’s market presence across Latin America. Write and oversee timely, insightful research on sector trends, market developments, and topical credit issues affecting the Energy, Power & Utilities space. Mentor and develop junior team members, helping to build analytical depth and succession within the franchise. What You Need to Have: 10+ years of relevant experience in credit analysis, project finance, capital markets, corporate or investment banking, or a related field. Strong knowledge of the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, ideally including exposure to regulated utilities, power generation, transmission, renewables, and/or midstream or energy infrastructure assets. Demonstrated experience managing people and/or leading teams in an analytical environment. Solid understanding of financial statement analysis, credit fundamentals, and debt capital structures. Proven ability to assess and explain analytically complex topics with sound judgment and intellectual rigor. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, master’s degree, CFA, CPA, or other advanced professional qualification preferred. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility with internal and external stakeholders. What Would Make You Stand Out: Deep knowledge of, and strong interest in, the Brazilian Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, with a desire to continue expanding expertise across related corporate and project finance subsectors. A strong professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis, supported by well-developed financial statement analysis and credit assessment skills. Demonstrated interest in deepening exposure to and understanding of the debt capital markets, particularly as they relate to Latin American issuers and infrastructure assets. A clear pattern of leadership, with the ability to proactively and effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally. Presence, judgment, and communication skills to represent Fitch credibly with issuer management teams, investors, bankers, and market participants. A collaborative mindset and a strong commitment to mentoring junior analysts and contributing to the development of the broader team. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Integrity Engineer
vagas.description: Location :Rio de Janeiro ERP Eligibility: ((cust_erp)) Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. Sumary: Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Key Responsibilities Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up‑to‑date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Key Competencies: Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi‑disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degreeis mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you! #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico. Sobre o Hospital Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Receber, conferir e armazenar os medicamentos e insumos; Controlar o estoque, distribuir, dispensar e fracionar medicamentos; Realizar a conferência da dispensação de medicamentos e insumos, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar o controle de temperatura do ambiente e geladeira; Confeccionar etiquetas para unitarização de doses de medicamentos; Separar medicamentos por paciente e/ou setores; Controlar os medicamentos devolvidos; Auxiliar na limpeza e organização do setor; Realizar todas as atividades pertinentes ao cargo, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar atividades de área/ setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor Imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino médio completo; Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo; Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia ou Auxiliar de Farmácia. Informações adicionais Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção. COMO É SER ESPECIALISTA EM GESTÃO DE PROJETOS EM MSF-BRASIL: Você irá definir e assegurar implementação de padrões para a gestão de projetos dentro do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, apoiando a tomada de decisão, garantindo uma execução eficiente de projetos, com qualidade e alinhada aos objetivos organizacionais. Irá facilitar a integração entre as diferentes áreas do Hub e demais departamentos, fomentando colaboração, aprendizado e excelência, elaborando e disseminando ferramentas, promovendo uma cultura ágil na organização, atuando na gestão de riscos e na maximização da contribuição de MSF-Brasil para sua missão social. 2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS? Garantir governança, previsibilidade e qualidade na entrega de um portfólio com demandas concorrentes, múltiplas partes interessadas e dependências entre áreas, equilibrando escopo, tempo, capacidade e impacto; Promover integração e alinhamento entre áreas e equipes de projetos, fortalecendo colaboração e cultura ágil (ritos, transparência e melhoria contínua), garantindo aprendizado e evolução de processos; Estruturar critérios claros de priorização e apoiar a tomada de decisão em contexto de recursos limitados e cenários dinâmicos; Identificar e mitigar barreiras organizacionais, operacionais ou de comunicação que possam limitar a participação equitativa das áreas e equipes nos projetos do portfólio. 3. COMO SERÁ O DIA A DIA? Gestão de portfólio, governança e planejamento Aconselhar a gestão do Hub na priorização de projetos com base em relevância, impacto, risco, dependências e alinhamento estratégico, garantindo transparência e visibilidade das prioridades para as equipes, apoiando a gestão de recursos e capacidades do Hub, alocação de pessoas para equipes de projetos e alertando sobre riscos e restrições; Coordenar todo o portfólio de projetos do Hub, garantindo clareza de papéis e responsabilidades, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados, visão consolidada e acompanhamento de status, dependências e marcos, reduzindo riscos de sobreposições e retrabalho; Apoiar a integração entre equipes de projetos, assegurando que objetivos, entregas e critérios de sucesso estejam conectados às estratégias e metas da organização, respeitando prazos e cronogramas pré-estabelecidos; Conduzir e supervisionar, em parceria com líderes de células e equipes de projetos, a realização de ritos ágeis e práticas acordadas, apoiando a integração, acompanhando a execução dos projetos e ferramentas necessárias, assegurando que objetivos, entregas e critérios de sucesso estejam conectados às estratégias e metas da organização, respeitando prazos e cronogramas pré-estabelecidos, incentivando práticas colaborativas, escuta ativa e participação efetiva dos diferentes atores envolvidos; Gerir diretamente alguns projetos estratégicos e/ou de grande porte, de acordo com critérios definidos (ex.: investimento, risco, transversalidade, criticidade para metas), assegurando governança, alinhamento e gestão de partes interessantes; Definir e garantir processos de transição de projetos para a rotina operacional, segundo critérios definidos, assegurando alinhamento entre partes envolvidas, continuidade das entregas, documentação de lições aprendidas e manutenção do histórico para aprendizado contínuo; Garantir que projetos tenham métricas claras, pertinentes, mensuráveis e alcançáveis, trabalhando em colaboração com a equipe de Inteligência de Dados, assegurando que relatórios integrados (status, riscos, marcos, capacidade e resultados) sejam disponibilizados às lideranças, monitoramento constante e tomada de decisão estratégica baseada em dados; Capacitação, gestão da mudança, melhoria contínua e cultura ágil Buscar continuamente formas de melhorar e otimizar processos de gestão de projetos, eliminando duplicações e retrabalho, definindo limites e acordos claros em todas as fases de execução; Apoiar a gestão da mudança associada a novos processos, ferramentas e iniciativas, promovendo adoção, alinhamento e engajamento das equipes envolvidas; Capacitar membros das equipes, incentivando o uso de metodologias ágeis, disseminando ferramentas, templates e boas práticas (planejamento, acompanhamento, comunicação e encerramento), em colaboração com o time de Projetos, Processos e Compliance (PPC) incentivando ambientes colaborativos, inclusivos e orientados à melhoria contínua; Promover transparência, ciclos curtos de entrega, melhoria contínua e tomada de decisão baseada em dados; Facilitar integração entre as lideranças do Hub, por meio de alinhamentos recorrentes, escalando impasses conforme a governança do Hub, além de garantir comunicação clara com partes interessadas, promovendo alinhamento de expectativas e suporte à implementação das entregas, identificando possíveis barreiras de comunicação, alinhamento ou participação e propondo soluções para sua mitigação; Garantir documentação, registro de lições aprendidas e gestão do conhecimento do portfólio continuamente; Compromissos Institucionais – MSF-Brasil Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho ético, equitativo e inclusivo, pautado pela escuta ativa, pelo respeito e pela colaboração; Conhecer e aplicar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização no exercício de suas atividades, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios institucionais; Colaborar com outras áreas e equipes de forma proativa, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do trabalho transversal e para a melhoria contínua de processos; Contribuir ativamente para a implementação dos objetivos definidos no Plano Anual e Resultados Esperados, com responsabilidade sobre suas entregas e atenção à qualidade do trabalho, participando de monitoramentos periódicos e ajustando prioridades; Impulsionar práticas que valorizem a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão em todas as ações e projetos das áreas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Requisitos Graduação completa em Gestão de Projetos, Marketing, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas Experiência e conhecimentos de gestão de projetos e/ou portfólio com múltiplos stakeholders e dependências Experiência em projetos de marketing, publicidade e/ou comunicação Vivência e conhecimentos de metodologias ágeis e práticas de trabalho em squads (ex.: Scrum, Kanban), incluindo facilitação de ritos e gestão de backlog Experiência em facilitação, coordenação transversal e gestão de mudanças/processos Conhecimentos de Pacote Office e domínio de ferramentas colaborativas para organização, acompanhamento e comunicação Capacidade de comunicação, negociação e resolução de conflitos 5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES: Certificação PMO Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas Conhecimentos ou proficiência em inglês 6. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS? Você precisará demonstrar iniciativa e inovação para antecipar oportunidades, transformar desafios em melhorias concretas e estimular uma atuação mais proativa e criativa no dia a dia da área, além de planejamento e organização para estruturar ações com clareza, alinhar prioridades, otimizar recursos e garantir a execução eficiente das atividades em conjunto com as equipes de projetos. Além disso, espera-se flexibilidade comportamental para apoiar e facilitar processos de mudança, contribuindo para a adaptação do time a diferentes contextos e necessidades, e pensamento analítico para interpretar informações de diferentes fontes, estabelecer prioridades e embasar decisões de forma estruturada, contribuindo para soluções consistentes e eficazes. MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstram alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas. Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, consideraremos apenas a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem como pessoas pretas ou pardas. vagas.title: Junior Media Buyer
vagas.description: Our client operates in the performance marketing space, managing campaigns across multiple advertising accounts and continuously testing, optimizing, and scaling what works. Their success depends on strong execution, sharp analysis, and a team that proactively seeks opportunities for improvement. They value people who take ownership, stay organized, and bring thoughtful recommendations—not just observations. This is a highly collaborative environment where initiative is rewarded, growth is encouraged, and strong performers have a clear path to advancing their careers. Job Description Time Zone : 40 hours/week | Significant overlap with US Eastern hours required (7+ hours daily - 9 AM - 5PM EST) Full-Time | Remote | Fast-Growth Marketing Team Launch Your Performance Marketing Career Are you obsessed with marketing, consumer psychology, and what makes ads convert? Do you find yourself analyzing ads while scrolling Instagram, wondering why some campaigns scale and others fail? We're looking for a driven Junior Media Buyer to join our client's team and help manage high-volume Meta advertising campaigns across multiple accounts. This role is ideal for a recent graduate early-career marketer with at least 1 year of hands‑on marketing experience and exposure to Meta Ads Manager. You'll work directly with experienced performance marketers, learn how winning campaigns are built, and develop the skills needed to become a high-level media buyer. This isn't a support role. This is the first step in a structured path toward becoming a Senior Media Buyer, with increasing responsibility, autonomy, and performance-based earning opportunities as you grow. If you're ambitious, analytical, competitive, and genuinely passionate about digital marketing, we'd love to see what you can do. Why This Opportunity Matters Performance marketing moves fast. Small improvements can create significant results, and the ability to spot opportunities before others do is incredibly valuable. In this role, you'll be at the center of campaign operations—analyzing performance, uncovering insights, monitoring competitors, and helping keep critical projects moving forward. Your work will help identify what's driving results, what needs improvement, and where the next growth opportunity lies. More importantly, this role is designed as a career launchpad. The right person won't stay a Junior Buyer forever. Our client is intentionally investing in someone with the potential to grow into a senior buying role, with increasing responsibility, autonomy, and performance-based earning potential along the way. What You'll Own As a Junior Affiliate Media Buyer, you'll become the operational heartbeat of a performance marketing pod. Analyze Meta Ad Performance Dive into campaign data daily to identify what's working, what's underperforming, and where opportunities exist. You'll review metrics such as: CTR CPC CPL CPA Conversion rates Spend efficiency And translate your findings into actionable recommendations. Research Winning Marketing Angles Study competitors, ad creatives, funnels, and market trends to uncover opportunities that can improve campaign performance. You'll be expected to think like a marketer, not just report numbers. Drive Execution Across the Team Work closely with our Creative Editor and Infrastructure Engineer to ensure priorities are clear and projects move forward efficiently. You'll help keep the entire marketing pod organized and focused on the highest-impact work. Document Insights & Opportunities Maintain clear records of tests, findings, recommendations, and account activity so the team can move quickly. Qualifications What Makes You Successful You'll thrive in this role if: Required Minimum 1 year of marketing experience Experience working with Meta Ads Manager Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills Excellent organization and attention to detail Ability to communicate insights clearly in written English Self-starter mentality and strong ownership Passion for digital marketing, advertising, and consumer behavior Availability to overlap significantly with US Eastern working hours Bonus Points If You Have Performance marketing experience Affiliate marketing or lead generation experience Experience using AdSpy tools Familiarity with tracking platforms such as RedTrack or Voluum Experience coordinating projects or small teams Additional Information What's In It For You Direct exposure to real-world performance marketing campaigns Mentorship from experienced media buyers and marketers A clear path toward a Senior Media Buying role Hands‑on experience analyzing and scaling campaigns Remote work flexibility Performance-based growth opportunities and incentives A team that values initiative, curiosity, and continuous learning Compensation of $1,200–$2,000 per month Performance-based incentives with long-term earning potential that can grow significantly as you demonstrate results #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Se você quer trabalhar com propósito e fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Somos uma rede que acredita no cuidado humanizado, na força do trabalho em equipe e no desenvolvimento contínuo de seus profissionais. Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuar na área/posição de Mecânico de Refrigeração, contribuindo para um atendimento seguro, humanizado e alinhado às melhores práticas. Aqui, você fará parte de um time comprometido com a qualidade do cuidado e a experiência do paciente, atuando de forma colaborativa e com foco contínuo em excelência. Responsabilidades e atribuições Executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva e instalação de equipamentos de refrigeração e ventilação em geral, como geladeira, bebedouro e aparelho de ar condicionado, instalando, reparando ou substituindo peças e fazendo os ajustes, regulagem e lubrificação convenientes, utilizando ferramentas comuns ou especiais, instrumentos e aparelhos de medição e controle, para assegurar aos sistemas funcionamento regular e eficientes, conforme os conhecimentos técnicos e científicos e as normas da Instituição, sob a luz do Código de Ética. Realizar todas as atividades mantendo o alinhamento às premissas de sustentabilidade para atender aos requisitos das Políticas ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance - Ambiental, Social e Governança) da Companhia; atender as metas definidas de acordo com sua área de atuação. Examinar, diariamente, os equipamentos de ventilação e/ou refrigeração da Unidade, utilizando ferramentas e instrumentos apropriados para identificação e localização dos defeitos. Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em equipamentos de ventilação, ar condicionado, bebedouros, geladeiras, demais equipamentos de refrigeração defeituosos, desmontando-os total ou parcialmente, trocando peças mecânicas avariadas, testando os sistemas de vedação e de isolamento, para corrigir irregularidades constatadas no seu funcionamento. Instalar equipamentos de ventilação e refrigeração, como ar condicionado, bebedouros, geladeiras, entre outros, nos locais definidos pelo superior imediato, bem como se baseando em esquemas e orientações discriminadas nos manuais dos fabricantes, semelhante a garantir o perfeito funcionamento dos equipamentos. Experiência na função Informações adicionais Você poderá ser direcionado(a) para oportunidades na unidade Balbino. Trabalhamos com diferentes escalas (diurno e/ou noturno), alinhadas à sua disponibilidade. Oferecemos treinamento inicial em horário comercial — é importante ter disponibilidade para essa etapa. customer behavior data to uncover drivers of reactivation, lead conversion, and churn recovery Build and manage the experimentation roadmap across messaging, incentives, audiences, channel mix, and timing Launch and scale lifecycle campaigns from ideation through rollout using Braze and in‑house tools Design, run, and analyze A/B tests that improve KPIs such as reactivation rate, lead‑to‑activation rate, and engagement Map consumer flows, identify friction points, and recommend scalable solutions or short‑term testing opportunities – define lifecycle KPIs, maintain reporting, and share clear insights, forecasts, variance explanations, and recommendations with stakeholders Partner with Creative, Product, Analytics, and FP&A to align lifecycle priorities and drive high‑impact growth initiatives Experience You Bring 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle or CRM marketing, consulting, analytics, or a data‑driven marketing role Hands‑on experience with user acquisition or growth marketing, including lead generation, conversion, and paid or owned acquisition channels Experience owning lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights, testing plans, and business recommendations Experience designing testing strategies, running A/B tests, and using results to improve campaign performance Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and campaigns with minimal oversight Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of basic SQL for self‑serve data pulls Familiarity with Braze or a comparable email or lifecycle service provider, and experience using project management software such as Asana or JIRA The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics. We are looking for a person who has Required Extensive experience as a senior / staff‑level engineer designing and evolving complex distributed systems or platform layers that serve multiple product teams. Nice to have Experience in lending, credit, or financial services platforms. Experience working in multi‑country or global product environments. vagas.title: Subsea Engineer
vagas.description: Purpose To ensure that the offshore subsea equipment spread is operated and maintained in an efficient, organised, and controlled manner in accordance with manufacturer operating manuals and project procedures. Carry out engineering duties within the back deck / subsea department, supporting the subsea team under the direction of the senior subsea lead. Develop technical knowledge and operational awareness to become fully conversant with the senior subsea engineer role. Operate as part of the vessel crew and work under the overall authority of the Vessel Master in line with vessel command structure. Duties & Responsibilities The Subsea Engineer shall: Uphold project safety and environmental policies and ensure defects, incidents, near misses, and non-conformances are reported and investigated in line with applicable procedures. Ensure that subsea personnel and technicians work in accordance with safe systems of work, including risk assessments and control measures prior to task execution. Support supervision and coordination of subsea department personnel, maintaining discipline and compliance with applicable maritime codes of conduct. Participate in vessel emergency response duties and drills as per the Muster List. Assist with inspection, testing, and basic maintenance of vessel safety systems, including fire detection and alarm systems where required. Take responsibility for safe and efficient operation of subsea systems when acting in a supervisory capacity or in the absence of the senior subsea lead. Demonstrate full understanding of senior subsea engineer responsibilities, including launch and recovery of subsea assets and operational decision-making offshore. Ensure subsea systems are operated within approved operational and insurance limitations. Manage subsea systems during maintenance, refurbishment, or standby periods. Coordinate subsea team activities including work allocation and watchkeeping in supervisory scenarios. Support planning and execution of maintenance, repair, and overhaul of subsea equipment to ensure operational readiness at all times. Escalate system downtime or reduced functionality to vessel leadership and onshore management where required. Assist with reporting, documentation, and technical returns for subsea systems. Maintain awareness of operational factors including vessel manoeuvrability, weather conditions, currents, and seabed characteristics. Support training and development of junior technicians and subsea personnel. Undertake additional duties within the subsea engineering discipline as required by vessel or project management. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Pessoa Analista de Folha de Pagamento Pleno
vagas.description: Descrição da Vaga Vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) Esta oportunidade de trabalho está aberta a qualquer pessoa, independentemente de religião, cor, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero. O CIEDS é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e está comprometido com inclusão, diversidade e igualdade de oportunidades. Desafios Buscamos uma Pessoa Analista de Folha de Pagamento Pleno com atuação generalista em Departamento Pessoal e sólida experiência nos processos de folha, encargos sociais e obrigações acessórias. O principal desafio da posição será garantir a correta execução da folha de pagamento, assegurando a conformidade das informações prestadas ao eSocial, DCTFWeb, FGTS Digital e demais órgãos fiscalizadores, mitigando riscos trabalhistas e previdenciários para a instituição. Além da atuação técnica em folha e encargos, o profissional deverá apoiar e acompanhar as demais rotinas de Administração de Pessoal, incluindo admissões, férias, rescisões, afastamentos, controle de jornada, benefícios e atendimento aos colaboradores. Espera-se uma postura analítica e proativa na identificação de inconsistências, revisão de processos, implementação de melhorias e apoio à gestão da área. A posição exige capacidade de atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, compartilhando conhecimento, apoiando profissionais menos experientes e contribuindo para a construção de processos mais eficientes, seguros e alinhados à legislação vigente. Também fará parte da missão do cargo participar de projetos de automação, integração de sistemas e aprimoramento dos controles internos da área de Departamento Pessoal. Principais Responsabilidades Processar, conferir e validar a folha de pagamento mensal, férias, 13º salário, rescisões e folhas complementares, garantindo a correta aplicação da legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e tributária; Realizar o fechamento e a conferência dos encargos sociais, incluindo INSS, FGTS Digital, IRRF e contribuições correlatas, assegurando a consistência dos valores e o cumprimento dos prazos legais; Administrar e monitorar os eventos do eSocial, promovendo a correta transmissão das informações e atuando na identificação, análise e regularização de inconsistências; Executar e acompanhar as obrigações acessórias da área, tais como DCTFWeb, FGTS Digital e demais declarações relacionadas à folha de pagamento; Atuar de forma generalista nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal, apoiando os processos de admissão, férias, afastamentos previdenciários, controle de jornada, benefícios e rescisões; Realizar análises e conciliações entre folha de pagamento, encargos, provisões e informações contábeis, garantindo a integridade dos dados e apoiando os processos de fechamento mensal; Prestar suporte técnico às áreas internas, gestores e colaboradores em temas relacionados à legislação trabalhista, folha de pagamento e administração de pessoal; Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fiscalizações e processos de compliance, fornecendo informações, relatórios e documentações necessárias; Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e padronização dos processos de Departamento Pessoal, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos; Atuar como referência técnica da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento, apoiando profissionais menos experientes e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento contínuo da área; Elaborar indicadores, controles e relatórios gerenciais relacionados à folha de pagamento, encargos e obrigações legais, apoiando a tomada de decisão da gestão. Diferencial Conhecimento em automação de processos será considerado diferencial, especialmente utilização de Power Query, VBA, AppScript, Google Sheets e ferramentas de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao Departamento Pessoal. Requisitos Escolaridade: Graduação; Nível: Pleno; Excel; Google Sheets; Power Query; VBA (Visual Basic for Applications); AppScript. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Bijbaan International Tax in Amsterdam
vagas.description: Als jij het in je hebt, krijg je bij Grant Thornton meteen alle ruimte. Om je talent te laten zien. Om baanbrekend werk te verzetten voor toonaangevende klanten. Of het nu gaat om belastingadvies, (duurzame) verslaglegging, cybersecurity of impactdashboards: we willen dat jij impact maakt. Want bij ons draait het om jou: niet alleen kun je helemaal jezelf zijn, maar je wordt vanaf het begin serieus genomen. Je draait volop mee, met de verantwoordelijkheid die daarbij hoort en de juiste begeleiding. Jij krijgt de kans je potentieel meteen te laten zien. Onze unieke cultuur creëert een omgeving waarin je je empowered voelt om die extra stap te zetten. En we moedigen diversiteit en inclusie aan zodat iedereen zich bij ons thuis voelt. In jouw bijbaan Tax bij Grant Thornton duik je in de wereld van internationale belastingen. Je ondersteunt je collega’s bij het voorbereiden van adviezen over internationale belastingvraagstukken. Je helpt mee met het uitwerken van vaktechnische onderwerpen en stelt eenvoudige aangiften vennootschapsbelasting op. Zo doe je waardevolle praktijkervaring op in een internationale omgeving, terwijl je jezelf stap voor stap ontwikkelt naast je studie. Je zet jouw eerste stappen in de wereld van International Tax en groeit elke dag een stukje verder in het vak. Samen met ervaren collega’s werk je aan internationale fiscale vraagstukken voor klanten in allerlei sectoren, van gaming tot de dienstensector. Daarbij krijg je de begeleiding én ruimte die je nodig hebt om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je leert niet alleen hoe je klanten het beste kunt adviseren, maar ontdekt ook hoe leuk het is om samen te werken met collega’s van internationale kantoren. Zo combineer je praktijkervaring met klantcontact en bouw je stap voor stap aan een stevige basis voor je toekomst. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Opstellen van (eenvoudige) aangiften vennootschapsbelasting; Assisteren bij het opstellen van internationale belastingadviezen; Voorbereiden en uitwerken van internationale fiscale vraagstukken; Coördineren van btw-registraties en klantvragen in diverse landen; Ondersteunen van collega's bij complexe belastingvraagstukken. Wat neem je mee? Je volgt een wo-master Fiscaal recht of Fiscale economie, of hebt deze afgerond; Je bent minimaal 3 maanden beschikbaar, met een inzet van ten minste 2 dagen per week; Je hebt affiniteit met international tax en bent enthousiast om te leren; Je werkt accuraat, systematisch en integer; Je bent communicatief vaardig in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Over het team Werken bij International Tax Services (ITS) betekent werken in een enthousiast, levendig en divers team van 20 collega’s. Vanaf dag één draai je mee op grote internationale klantdossiers. Je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. De lijnen zijn kort, ook met partners, en je werkt samen met verschillende collega’s, niet alleen je Development Manager. Dankzij wekelijkse vaktechnische overleggen, 1-op-1 begeleiding en de mogelijkheid tot internationale secondments, groei je snel in je rol én als mens. Je werkt op ons kantoor in Amsterdam, verdeeld over twee open verdiepingen met uitzicht op de Johan Cruijff ArenA en de Ziggo Dome. Een inspirerende plek waar je samenwerkt met collega’s uit alle disciplines aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Wat bieden wij jou? Jouw carrière. Jouw keuze. Bij Grant Thornton krijg je de ruimte om te ontdekken, te groeien en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je wordt actief begeleid door een mentor en werkt in een omgeving waar persoonlijke aandacht en professionele groei centraal staan. We geloven in vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid zodat jij het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Salaris van € 18,29 per uur, inclusief vakantietoeslag; Begeleiding door een Development Manager waar je altijd terecht kunt. Grant Thornton is een netwerkorganisatie van wereldniveau. Internationaal zijn we één van de grootste accountants- en adviesorganisaties, een zevende plek wereldwijd! Hier in Nederland hebben we de fantastische voordelen van een kleinere organisatie met open cultuur, met de internationale mogelijkheden en multiculturele ervaring van één van de grootste organisaties ter wereld. Wij gaan altijd een stapje verder. Voor onze klanten en vooral ook voor jou. Zodat jij de allerbeste werkomgeving hebt, die inclusief is en waar we flink bezig zijn met duurzaamheid. We werken voor profit- én non-profitorganisaties. Specialiseer je zoals jij wilt en werk zo iedere dag aan een wereld die past bij jouw idealen en doelen. Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij kunt groeien én bijdragen bij Grant Thornton! Meer weten over deze rol of werken bij Grant Thornton? Anne Baas of ) staat klaar om je verder te helpen. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Diretor(a) de Unidade - Rio de Janeiro
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Quer ser um diretor escolar de excelência? Vem com a gente! Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Aqui no Grupo Salta, oferecemos a chance de iniciar uma jornada que vai expandir ainda mais o seu potencial. Ao fazer parte do nosso time de diretores, você vai liderar uma das escolas do maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil, inspirando as vidas da sua comunidade escolar e deixando a sua marca no cenário educacional do nosso país. Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil. O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado! Responsabilidades e atribuições Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais. Gestão do calendário escolar, projetos e eventos pedagógicos da escola: garantir o cumprimento do calendário escolar, considerando excelência, qualidade técnica, comunicação e alinhamento à cultura da escola de todos os projetos e eventos pedagógicos. Atendimento aos responsáveis: manter um canal de comunicação eficaz e acolhedor com os pais e responsáveis, garantindo o esclarecimento de dúvidas, resolução de problemas e a construção de uma relação de confiança com a comunidade escolar. Desenvolvimento de equipe: promover a formação contínua de professores e funcionários, garantindo alinhamento às metas da escola e atualização pedagógica constante, além de realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho docente, com feedback e suporte para aprimoramento. Captação e retenção de alunos: atuar em estratégias de marketing educacional, elaborando planos de captação e fidelização de alunos, e promover uma experiência positiva para as famílias, consolidando a escola como referência de excelência na região. Inovação e excelência: incentivar a integração de tecnologia e práticas inovadoras no ensino, acompanhando tendências educacionais e implementando melhorias contínuas no currículo e na metodologia da escola. Requisitos e qualificações Formação superior completa em Pedagogia, Educação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em gestão escolar, preferencialmente em instituições de grande porte. Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e tomada de decisão. Cursar ou ter cursado pós‑graduação em Gestão Escolar é um diferencial. Informações adicionais Carga horária: 44 horas semanais. Local: Rio de Janeiro Nós oferecemos Vale‑Transporte; Assistência médica e odontológica; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Day off no mês do aniversário; Ambiente Salta de Aprendizagem; Parcerias no Salta +Benefícios; Seu filho(a) tem direito a bolsa escolar (consulte a equipe de Gente e Gestão para verificar as regras). Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições. Fique tranquilo(a) ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. O Grupo Salta segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709/2018), que entrou em vigor em agosto de 2020, logo, garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Brazil - Hybrid: Senior Software Developer - Platform & Complex Systems
vagas.description: Senior Software Developer – Platform & Complex Systems (Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting) About This Job Posting This job posting is designed to attract senior-level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale. This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development. This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection. What You Will Work On Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems Work on large-scale, distributed, and performance-sensitive applications Contribute to system architecture and technical decision-making Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor Continuously expand your technical skills and system-level expertise Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms) For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms. Typical focus areas: Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) SQL and NoSQL databases Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization. Typical focus areas: Full stack or backend development Performance profiling and tuning of distributed systems Kubernetes optimization and cloud resource efficiency Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems) For developers working close to the core of high‑performance, engineering‑heavy software. Typical focus areas: Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued) Performance‑critical and system‑level applications Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving Integration with databases, APIs, and external services Working with complex legacy and modernized systems Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability. Typical focus areas: Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios Partnering closely with developers to improve system robustness This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation. What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks) Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in: Computer Science Software, Systems, or Engineering disciplines Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams Good communication skills in English Motivation to grow as a senior or lead individual contributor Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks. Why Join Landmark Work on platforms and complex systems, not just features Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors Location & Work Model This job posting is open to candidates based in Brazil or Colombia, with full collaboration across global teams. Hybrid (occasional on‑site collaboration, depending on team and project needs) This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment. Specific project timelines may vary by technical track and team assignment and will be discussed during the interview process. Additional Information This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection. Applicants must select their technical track as part of the application process so they can be considered for the appropriate role covered by this posting. Equal Opportunity Statement Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation. Compensation Information Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Job Segment: Cloud, Testing, Developer, QA, Quality Assurance, Technology, Quality #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Wayfinding and Signage Manager
vagas.description: Wayfinding and Signage Manager Department: Technical & Infrastructure Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Wayfinding and Signage Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Wayfinding and Signage Manager is responsible for leading the wayfinding and signage implementation, operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class wayfinding and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, ensuring that the wayfinding and signage is up to FIFA quality standards. They will be initially responsible for the technical development of wayfinding signage guidelines and principles in collaboration with the contracted provider(s), department senior team and the other Cluster Managers. Subsequently, the candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at stadiums and other official sites. In all aspects of their role, they will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations, ensuring that they are managed efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. In addition, they will take guidance from other cluster managers to ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027. Providing expertise in assisting in the compilation of technical wayfinding signage guidelines, principles and templates. Inputting into the development of the wayfinding signage system(s) used to assist with the planning of the project. Providing strategic input into the development and implementation of the wayfinding signage kit of parts to be utilized at all official sites. Overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 stadiums in Brazil. Working with other Cluster Managers ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all sites within the sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of allocated wayfinding operations and reporting updates to senior department members. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with site owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Attending department‑specific and organization site visits at both assigned sites and potentially additional official sites. Acting as the main wayfinding point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. YOUR PROFILE Relevant experience in delivering wayfinding and signage projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. and experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive wayfinding and signage related activities. Experience in devising technical guidelines and wayfinding signage kit of parts for large‑scale events. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) Strong understanding of stadium wayfinding and signage requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑fased events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education). Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Realização de visitas e inspeções em instalações das contratadas ou da Petrobras, com o objetivo de verificar o cumprimento dos requisitos estabelecidos nos Anexos de SMS dos contratos vigentes com a Petrobras; Assessoria na aplicação de padrões, programas, requisitos legais e políticas corporativas da Petrobras na execução dos contratos de serviços, sempre que aplicável, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes estabelecidas e a conformidade com as normas vigentes. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Workforce Training Manager Department: Workforce, People & Culture Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting to the Senior Manager Workforce Operations, the Workforce Training Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Workforce Management team, and work in close collaboration with operational delivery Functional Areas within FIFA27, as well as People & Culture in FIFA Zurich, and other key individuals responsible for delivering a cohesive, consistent, and operationally appropriate training programme for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Key Responsibilities Training Coordination and Project Management Develop and implement a comprehensive training plan that aligns with tournament deliverables/objectives and Functional Area requirements. Coordinate with department heads, trainers/training providers, and other stakeholders to assess and define the training needs strategy. Establish a coordinated and integrated training journey for the tournament workforce, across multiple client groups from planning and development to execution and evaluation. In collaboration with FA Leads training delivery mechanisms for whole client group training sessions and support/provide guidance to Functional Areas on appropriate training schedules, venues, and resources to ensure timely and effective delivery of training programs. Ensure training programs are consistent, culturally appropriate, and tailored to meet the specific needs of different regions. Manage the creation and distribution of template training materials, including accessibility considerations, such as multiple languages. Track and report on the progress of training initiatives, managing any changes, delays, or risks. Ensure alignment with the event's objectives, ensuring that efficient and effective training delivery supports the overall success of the Tournament being delivered. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with internal teams (Workforce, Planning & Integration, Volunteer Management, HR, Operations, Security, Technology, etc.), external vendors, and consultants to facilitate consistent training delivery. Serve as the primary point of contact for all organisation-wide training-related planning, inquiries and concerns. Regularly communicate with leadership to provide updates on the progress of training initiatives and address any challenges. Monitoring and Evaluation In collaboration with the Senior Manager Workforce Operations, oversee budget requirements for organizational training initiatives, ensuring efficiencies are kept at front of mind. Work in close collaboration with Planning & Integration to create tools that support the effective evaluation of training programs through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics. Adjust training plans and methods based on feedback from trainees and trainers to ensure continuous improvement from one Tournament to the next. Prepare detailed reports on training outcomes, including participant performance, satisfaction, and areas for improvement. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education. Experience Solid experience designing and delivering Training/Learning and Development programmes in a fast‑paced environment. Demonstrated experience of utilising strong organisational skills and attention to detail to switch from strategic to detailed planning. Significant experience designing and delivering Training/L&D programmes within the Sporting Industry/large‑scale events.
